text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
――なっ！？
お前は、白髪鬼――！？
text.official_en: What?! The White-Maned Demon—here?!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どういう事だ、
なぜお前がブレザラントの王になど……
text.official_en:
I demand an explanation. How did you come to be
king of Brezarant?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
話は後だ、サラミス王セオドラ。
まずは、この戦いに勝利しよう。
text.official_en:
Let's catch up later, shall we, Queen of Saramis?
There's a battle for us to win.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一体、何が起こっているというのだ……
だが、確かにお前の言う通りだ。
text.official_en:
I wish I understood what is happening here. But you
are correct that it can wait.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
敵の士気が大きく削がれた今こそが好機だ！
連中に、立て直す暇を与えるな！
text.official_en:
Strike now, while our enemy is reeling! Do not give
them an opportunity to regroup!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
全軍突撃せよ！
眼の前の敵を掃討するのだ！
text.official_en: All troops, forward, and wipe out any foe before you!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……退くがいい、カイ。
お前の母君を……悲しませるな。
text.official_en: Withdraw, Cai, or risk bringing grief to your mother.
text.real_en: Withdraw, Kai, or risk bringing grief to your mother.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ごめんね、セオドラ姉ちゃん。
だけど、そういうわけにも行かなくってさ……
text.official_en: I'm sorry, Theodora, but I can't do that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こんな所で何やってるのよ。
早く家族のところに戻りなさい！
text.official_en:
What are you doing here? Go away. Get back to
your family!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ごめんよ、レダ姉ちゃん。
なんでこんな事になっちゃったのかな……
text.official_en: I'm sorry, Leda. How did it come to this?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
カイ、もうやめようよ！
一緒に村に帰ろう！
text.official_en:
Cai, we don't have to do this! Let's go back to the
village together!
text.real_en:
Kai, we don't have to do this! Let's go back to the
village together!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ごめん、ピーテル。でも、親父のことは、
オレが面倒みてやらなくちゃ……可哀想じゃん？
text.official_en: I'm sorry, Peter, but someone has to look out for Pop.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
御子様、ここは退いて！
あなたと戦うわけには……！
text.official_en: Cai, you have to retreat! I can't fight you!
text.real_en: Kai, you have to retreat! I can't fight you!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ごめんね、ウルタンド姉ちゃん。
ねえ、オレ、どこかで間違えたのかな……
text.official_en: I'm sorry, Ultand, for any mistakes that led me here.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
本当は戦争なんて嫌だけど……
こうしなきゃ、親父を助けられないんだ。
text.official_en:
I don't want war, but this is the only way for me to
save Pop.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダ姉ちゃん、
なんでこんなとこに居るんだよ！？
text.official_en: Leda, what are you doing here?!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どきなさい、カイ。
あなたみたいな幸せな子供にはわからないわ。
text.official_en:
Step aside, Cai. You've had a happy childhood—
you would never understand my motivations.
text.real_en:
Step aside, Kai. You've had a happy childhood—
you would never understand my motivations.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ベルトラン……！
ここが、あなたの死に場所よ……！
text.official_en:
Look around, Bertrand. This is the place where
you die!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダ嬢……貴女は本当に、
これでよかったのか……？
text.official_en: Miss Leda...is this really what you want?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いいからかかってきなさい、シロッコ。
油断してると大火傷するわよ。
text.official_en:
Shut up and have at me, Sirocco, before I burn you to
a crisp.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダさん、やめてよ！
ボク、あなたとは戦いたくないのに！
text.official_en: Leda, please don't do this! I don't want to fight you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ムウ、あなたまで……あなたまでも、
あたしの事を邪魔しようっていうの？
text.official_en:
Then why are you standing in the way of my
vengeance?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
オリンピア……よかったわね。
今日こそ決着をつけられるじゃない。
text.official_en:
It's your lucky day, Olympia! We can finally settle
this ridiculous feud.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レイリダーナ……あたくしが望んでいたのは、
こんな形ではありませんでしたのに……
text.official_en: Leilidahna, this isn't the ending I had in mind.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……あいつを殺すためならば。
たとえ、何を犠牲にしたって構わないわ。
text.official_en:
I'll sacrifice anything—everything!—if it means
he dies.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
相手にとって不足はない！
ネイサン“カトブレパス”バカウディ、参る！
text.official_en:
If you're looking for a worthy foe, look no further.
The Catoblepas, Nathan Bakaudi, has arrived!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
キリーク“パンター”アバンシオ、
その生命、頂戴つかまつる！
text.official_en:
I am Creek Avancio, the Pantere, and I have come
to claim your life.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ば、馬鹿な……！
ここまで攻め上がられるなどと……！
text.official_en:
This is absurd! How could they have pressed the
attack this far?!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザ帝国に歯向かう愚か者共よ……
ここでその骸を晒すがいい……！
text.official_en:
Traitors to the Dagdan Empire... Your corpses will
be mounted as a warning to all who defy us!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……やむを得ん。
アグリス関まで退却し、態勢を立て直すか……
text.official_en:
They've left us no choice but to retreat and regroup
at Agris Stronghold.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
かりそめの勝利に沸くがいい、叛徒の群れよ。
お前たちとの決着は、預けておくぞ……
text.official_en:
Enjoy your fleeting victory, insurgents. I'll be settling
the score with you later.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
敵の大将リンドは倒れた！
残敵を一掃せよ！
text.official_en:
The enemy general has fallen! Let us dispose of
his dregs.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ここで武勲をあげさえすれば、
親父を助け出すことができる。
text.official_en:
If I can make a name for myself in this fight, then
maybe I can rescue my dad.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
セオドラ姉ちゃん……本当にごめん。
オレにはもう、こうするしかないんだ。
text.official_en:
Theodora... I'm really sorry, but this is the only
choice I have left.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
カイのために、あたしは絶対にここで
引くわけにはいかないの。
text.official_en: I absolutely will not retreat. For Cai's sake.
text.real_en: I absolutely will not retreat. For Kai's sake.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
死に場所を探して流れ着いた戦場で、
まさか、あなたに会えるなんて……
text.official_en:
I drifted here in search of a place to die...and now I
meet you! Of all people!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
覚悟なさい、ベルトラン……！
今度こそあたしはすべてを終わらせるわ！
text.official_en: It's over, Bertrand. I'm ending you!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダ様……それがしはどこまでも
供をさせていただく所存にござる。
text.official_en: I will accompany milady until the bitter end.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
如何な大要塞といえども、ひとたび
懐に入り込んでしまえば恐れることはない！
text.official_en:
Do not be intimidated by the fortress's reputation.
In the end, it is a bastion like any other.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
各自、敵の防衛戦力に気をつけつつ、
慎重かつ大胆に攻め上がれ！
text.official_en:
Keep one eye on the enemy's defensive forces,
and press the attack with vigor!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
帝国に逆らう叛徒どもめ……
この俺の誇りにかけても抜かさせはしない！
text.official_en: On my honor, no traitor against the empire will pass!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
貴公らに感謝せねばなるまい。
俺は今、かつて無い程の昂りを感じている！
text.official_en:
I find myself grateful to your army. This battle is
more thrilling than any I've ever fought!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうした……
何故、俺に止めをささぬ……？
text.official_en: Well? Why have you not struck the killing blow?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふっ……まさかこの俺が、こんなところで
敵に情けをかけられ、死に損なうなどと……
text.official_en:
Heh. This is the last place I had expected such
a show of mercy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そういえば、貴公らにはひとつ、
大きな借りがあったのだったか……
text.official_en: In all honesty...I owe the lot of you a debt.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……よかろう。このキリーク・アバンシオ、
恩義に報いるため、力を貸そう。
text.official_en:
And so it shall be repaid. I, Creek Avancio, am at
your army's service.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こ、このアグリス関が攻め込まれるなど、
わが帝国の歴史始まって以来の大事……
text.official_en:
No one...no one has ever dared to assault Agris
Stronghold in the history of our empire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
――え、ええい、
奮い立つのだ、ヤヌアリウス！
text.official_en: Come on, Ianuarius! Get a hold of yourself!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この危機は、儂が武功をあげる絶好の機会！
今こそ不退転の覚悟で挑むのだ！
text.official_en:
Now is my chance to show I'm equal to such a dismal
situation. This is my time to shine!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私がこのアグリス砦を預かった以上、
貴様たちごときに、落とさせはしない。
text.official_en:
Agris Stronghold is mine. And I won't let you
wretches take it from me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……どうやら、潮時のようだな。
この砦は放棄せざるを得ぬか……
text.official_en:
Very well then, the fortress is yours. You've forced
my hand.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが……これで勝ったなどと思わぬことだ。
かりそめの勝利を味わうがいい……
text.official_en:
But don't confuse victory here with winning the war.
Savor these small triumphs while you can...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……奴の最後の言葉、何か引っかかる。
どういう意味だ？
text.official_en: That's...disquieting. What do you think he meant?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
敵の大将リンドは倒れた……！
副将のヤヌアリウスも討ち取れ！
text.official_en:
General Lind has withdrawn! Make Lieutenant
Ianuarius your next priority!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
副将のヤヌアリウスを倒したか……
この勢いでリンドを討て！
text.official_en:
We have dispatched Lieutenant Ianuarius.
But let us not rest until General Lind falls!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……このような形でグラン・アラゴンの土を
再び踏むことになるとは、皮肉な話だ。
text.official_en:
I finally return to Grand Aragon...and I'm here to
attack it. Strange.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、これは私怨ではない。正義の為に、
俺は自らの意志で祖国に対し……弓を引く！
text.official_en:
But I'm not here for revenge—it's for justice that I
turn my blade against my homeland.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タホウニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アスワン様、御覧ください！
連合軍が来ています！
text.official_en: Queen Aswan, look. The Alliance!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
王都の中は防衛のための兵士が配備されていて
迂闊には動けそうにないわ。
text.official_en:
There are soldiers stationed everywhere defending
the capital. We must move carefully.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まずは、追手に対処しながら、
連合軍と合流しなければ……
text.official_en:
Evade capture, and reach the Alliance as soon
as we can.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我が王はまだ健在か。
どうやら間に合ったようだな。
text.official_en:
Is my king still alive and well? Good, then I'm not
too late.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
馬鹿な、あの男、この短期間のうちに
前線からここまで駆け戻ったというのか？
text.official_en:
How could that man have sped here from the front
lines in so short a time?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ギルキルス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おお、ネイサンか。よく戻った！
お前はそこでこの僕を守れ！　守るのだ！
text.official_en:
Yes, well done, Nathan. Now, protect me.
Protect me, I say!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ギルキルス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
クソっ、この役立たずめ、
壁がわりの役目すら果たせぬとは……
text.official_en:
Died like a dog. Useless! You were supposed to keep
me safe!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
君は、アスワン……！？
一体なぜ、こんなところに……
text.official_en: Aswan! What are you doing out here?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ベルトラン、お願い。
私もあなたたちと共に戦わせて！
text.official_en: I want to help!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
自分の国を裏切ることになるぞ。
それでも君は……構わないのか？
text.official_en:
You mean...join the battle against your own country?
Are you certain?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ええ、
もう、その覚悟はできているから……
text.official_en: Yes. I am firm in my decision.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わかった。ただ、一つだけ約束してくれ。
生命を粗末にするような真似はしないと。
text.official_en: Very well, Aswan. But promise me you will survive.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
連合軍の方ですね。ここからは、私も
あなたたちと共に戦わせてください。
text.official_en:
You there! You're in the Alliance, right? Let me
help you!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アスワン！？　あなた、この国の王妃のくせに
こんなところで何してるのよ。
text.official_en: Aswan? You're the queen. What are you doing here?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
